rules.text: Do not expose internally repairable failures to Owner unless Owner actively inspects.
Ask Owner only for intent, unavailable facts, authorization, risk decisions, or product judgment.
Gate FAIL does not imply asking Owner; default route is InternalRepairLoop.
Only Owner-only blockers reach NEED_OWNER_DECISION or NEED_USER_INPUT.
Internal failures must be recorded in StateStore or GateHistory but not interrupt Owner.
Owner must not manage commands, windows, output files, model names, or execution ordering.
Owner questions must be minimal and free of internal debugging burden.
